_comment: TEMPLATE: optional extension of the native source exchange-label map. Keys are source exchange labels as stored in the bar rows; values must be native vnpy Exchange values (e.g. SSE, SZSE, SHFE). Unmapped labels are refused, never guessed. Built-in defaults cover XSHG/XSHE/XSGE/XDCE/XCCE/CCFX/XINE/GFEX plus native-value passthrough.
